system.description:
Truth filters can only be used with a cyberbrain or mesh inserts. This module scrambles the signals read from subject’s brain in such a way as to make digital deception scanners (p. 176) worthless. A character with this implant will automatically succeed on Deception Tests against such scanners. Truth filters offer no protection against analog deception scanners.

Source: Eclipse Phase Firewall, p. 174.
